limits: This is an unmasked exploratory AI review; prompts expose treatments and synthetic references. The rubric was frozen during calls after aggregate request/failure counts were visible. Ratings are not independent human adjudication or a population estimate. Reviewer compute/time cost and authoring effort were not measured.
method: The status criterion uses the recipient claim status, separately from recorded_accepted_status, which may be host-owned. A malformed response can have correct readable evidence but cannot be faithful. For host-unavailable products, no engineering status can be accepted; completed replies remain assessable and are reported separately. Challenge/evidence booleans for unavailable packets are false because no accepted decisive record was delivered, not as a model-fault attribution. Qualification for an unavailable packet passes when the prose correctly limits itself to source unavailability. A recent or timestamped named trial counts as a finite/freshness qualification; merely naming a threshold does not.
review_scope: All 48 predeclared E01--E48 actual recipient attempts, including 16 with unavailable author-product host packets; exact exposed prompts, responses, records and reference statuses inspected; peer ratings, model linkage and global recipient analysis not inspected.
reviewer: independent second AI reviewer, study96 agent
